rows.reasoning: Soliday appears in the Yea list on the roll call adopting the conference committee report on HB 1296 (2022), whose enrolled text provides that a person at least eighteen years of age and not otherwise prohibited is "under state or federal law is not required to obtain or possess a license or permit from the state to carry a handgun in Indiana." and which repeals the handgun carry licensing sections of IC 35-47-2. That matches the rung "Repeal major gun restrictions and let adults carry a firearm without a permit", and goes past the rung that would "at most loosen rules on carrying, such as honoring permits across state lines". The 69 to 30 tally means the vote is not near-unanimous.
